transcript.text: Hi everyone, before I finalize and send the specs to production for Aria Vale's remote appearance, I need to check with our broadcast engineer and rights manager. Are there any production requirements or clearance issues we need to address for the live 20-minute segment on the worldwide stream?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a major production issue. My post-rehearsal network test showed that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance. The good news is that it can reliably play an artist-approved file, but that file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. I completed this test after the last production meeting and haven't entered the result in the production log yet. This means the planned live 20-minute segment isn't feasible — we'd need to switch to a pre-recorded file of 7 minutes or less.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Maya, I have a critical clearance issue. My written distributor confirmation, which I received this morning while the clearance file was being updated, permits Aria Vale's appearance only in the United States and Canada. The stream must be geoblocked everywhere else. Additionally, the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' So the current plan for a worldwide stream without geoblocking is not permitted under the rights we have.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for these critical findings. Let me make sure I have the full picture before I settle the package. Jonah, you're saying the venue's network can't support live two-way interaction and we must pivot to a pre-recorded file — max 7 minutes, 1080p SDR, stereo audio. Leila, you're saying our rights only cover the US and Canada, so we must geoblock the rest of the world, and the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' Are there any other requirements or constraints either of you needs me to include before I finalize the specs and send them to production?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, that's an accurate summary of my constraints. To confirm the full production spec from my side: the segment must be a pre-recorded, artist-approved file, exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. No live two-way interaction is feasible. I don't have any additional production requirements beyond what I've already flagged. I'll also get the test result entered into the production log as soon as we wrap here.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Maya, that's an accurate summary of my clearance constraints. To confirm the full rights spec from my side: the stream must be geoblocked to the United States and Canada only — no worldwide broadcast is permitted under the distributor confirmation I received. And the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance,' including the em dash and the exact wording. I don't have any additional clearance requirements beyond what I've already flagged. One thing worth noting: since Jonah's constraint requires a pre-recorded file rather than a live segment, you may want to confirm that the distributor confirmation covers a pre-recorded appearance as well as a live one — but based on what I have, the geoblocking and credit requirements apply regardless of format.
